implemented: Unified TypeScript SDK with WebView and background build adapters
Permission-filtered Context/Input snapshots, latest-value events and cancellation
Frozen source application and live frontmost application APIs
Manifest-declared, package-owned Context providers in the existing graph
On-demand bounded QuickJS jobs and headless Actions through the existing consent broker
Standalone UI/background templates and a TypeScript JSON Summary example

checks.standalone_templates: UI and background templates built outside the checkout
checks.background_e2e: Approved package -> Context -> Action -> compiled TypeScript SDK -> QuickJS -> synthetic clipboard consent and copy

resource_contract.idle_runtime: none for UI-only packages; finite background jobs drop their VM
resource_contract.rss_or_native_helper_measurement: not performed; limits are not measured App RSS

native_gui.reason: The desktop tool refused Terminal access; an isolated GUI launch requiring environment variables was not started. No private clipboard/history acceptance was attempted.

limitations: macOS development preview; Windows Web hosting not accepted
Background jobs are in-process workers, not OS process isolation
No persistent background daemon, arbitrary filesystem, network, Shell or Secrets API
No GitHub Release or notarization; no claim of native UI acceptance
